At the [EGU General Assembly 2025](https://www.egu25.eu/) in Vienna I presented two posters:

- **Transforming Low-Resolution CORINE Data into High-Resolution Landscape Maps with Semi-Supervised Deep Learning**
- **Advancing Crop Yield Predictions: The Potential of Diffusion Models in Machine Learning for Agriculture**

Both are listed on my [presentations page](../presentations.html).
